links.outcome: Within-person association of generative AI dependency with later metacognitive awareness and self-perceived clinical decision-making
links.effect: Higher dependency predicted lower metacognitive awareness at next wave (β = -0.18 to -0.21, p < .001); indirect effect on decision-making via metacognition = -0.045, 95% CI [-0.074, -0.019]; direct effect not significant.
links.quote: At the within-person level, higher generative artificial intelligence dependency was prospectively associated with lower metacognitive awareness at the subsequent wave (β = -0.18 to -0.21, p < .001).

unlisted_practices: Pair AI use in nursing education with metacognitive scaffolding, verification routines, and reflective assessment

screen.reason: Prospective longitudinal survey study of nursing students examining how generative AI dependency affects metacognitive awareness and clinical decision-making skills.
